hikes.name: Salt Creek and Diamond Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: Oregon's second-tallest falls, then through forest to a lacy fan of water in a mossy amphitheatre.

hikes.name: The Twins
hikes.blurb: A gentle climb to a cinder summit with Waldo Lake's huge blue sheet spread below.

hikes.name: Maiden Peak
hikes.blurb: A long climb to a broad volcano's top with the Sisters, Diamond Peak and Waldo Lake all around.

hikes.name: Fuji Mountain
hikes.blurb: A short climb to a rocky summit above Waldo Lake and the Cascade crest.

hikes.name: Rosary Lakes
hikes.blurb: North on the Pacific Crest Trail to three lakes under the cliffs of Pulpit Rock.

hikes.name: Bobby Lake
hikes.blurb: An easy walk through mountain hemlock to a swimming lake under Maiden Peak.

hikes.name: Rigdon Lakes
hikes.blurb: Along Waldo Lake's north shore to two small lakes and a butte in the old burn.

hikes.name: Willamette Pass
hikes.blurb: From Marilyn Lakes Trailhead, a 15.2-mile round trip to Willamette Pass, with about 2,150 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Diamond Peak
hikes.blurb: From Rockpile Trailhead, an 11.0-mile round trip to the top of Diamond Peak (8,722 ft), with about 3,850 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Heckletooth Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Eugene To Pacific Crest Trailhead, a 10.9-mile round trip to the top of Heckletooth Mountain (3,670 ft), with about 3,250 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Waldo Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Swan Lake Trailhead, an 8.6-mile round trip to the top of Waldo Mountain (6,337 ft), with about 2,300 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Otter Lake
hikes.blurb: From Erma Bell Trailhead, a 6.7-mile round trip to Otter Lake, with about 900 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Little Cultus Lake
hikes.blurb: From Many Lakes Trailhead, an 11.0-mile round trip to Little Cultus Lake, with about 850 feet of climbing.
